## Problem

## Change

## Evidence

Commands, actual outcomes, artifact links, and applicable environment/version tuple.

## Limits

Failed/skipped checks, unknowns, processor/server parity, and next milestone gate.

- [ ] CHANGELOG and implementation-state describe actual changes and results.
- [ ] No private media, secrets, model weights, or misleading measurements.
- [ ] Commits have the contributor's DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] Owner acceptance is recorded only after verification.
